chapter.verse: Paisan kici silngo om lo khomun pawikham ding a nai zo hi.
Siampi liante leh laitheite in Zeisu bangci thatlum ding ci-in a zong uh hi. Bang hang hiam i cih leh, amaute in mite a kihta uh hi.
Tua lai takin Satan in sawm-le-nihte lakah khat Iskariot kici Judah sungah a lut hi.
Amah siampi liante leh biakna innpi palik mangte kiangah va pai a, amaute khut tungah Zeisu bangci piak theih ding ci-in a vaihawm uh hi.
Amaute nuam uh a, “Dangka-in kong guai ding uh hi,” ci-in a kiciam uh hi.
Amah in zong mang a, mihonpi a om loh lai takin Topa amaute khut tungah a piak theih nading a zong hi.
Paisan tuuno a kigawh nading, silngo om lo khomun nek pawikham ni a tun’ ciangin Zeisu in Piter leh Johan kiangah, “Pai un la, Paisan pawi an nek ding na bawl un,” ci-in a sawl hi,
amau in, “Koi lai takah hong bawlsak le-ung na deih hiam?” ci-in a dong uh hi.
Zeisu in, “Khua sungah na tum uh ciangin, tuibeel a pua mi khat tawh na kituak ding uh hi. Tua mi a lutna inn sungah na zui un la,
inn neipa kiangah, ‘Sia in, Keimah in ka nungzuite tawh Paisan pawi ka nek nadingin zin tun’na inndei koi lai-ah a om hiam? a ci hi,’ ci-in na gen un.
Tua mi in a kibawlsa dei tungnung a lian khat hong lak ding hi. Tua dei sungah na bawl khol un,” ci-in a sawl hi.
Amaute pai uh a, Zeisu gen mah bangin a mu uh a; Paisan pawi nek ding a bawl uh hi.
A hun a tun’ ciangin Zeisu in a sawltakte tawh a tukhawm hi.
Zeisu in, “Ka sih ma-in hih Paisan pawi note tawh nekkhop ka ut mahmah hi.
Ke’n kong cih-inah, Pasian’ Gam sungah deihna a kicin’ matengin, hih pawi ka ne nawn kei ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua lai takin Zeisu in hai la a, hehpihna a phat khit ciangin, “Hih hai la un la, note lakah na hawm tek un.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Pasian’ Gam a hong tun’ matengin tu-a kipan, leenggahtui ka dawn nawn kei ding hi,” a ci hi.
Amah in khomun la a, hehpihna a phat khit ciangin, khomun balnenin, “Hih khomun in note ading a kipia ka pumpi ahi hi. Kei nong ngaihsut nadingun hih bangin na hih un,” ci-in a nungzuite a pia hi.
Tua mah bangin an a nek khit uh ciangin hai la a, “Hih hai in note ading a kibua, kiciamna thak a lak ka si ahi hi.
Ahih hangin kei hong lehheekpa’ khut in sabuai tungah keima khut tawh a omkhawm hi.
Mihing Tapa in a kisehkhol mah bangin a pai ding hi. Ahih hangin amah a lehheekpa in gimna a thuak ding hi,” a ci hi.
A nungzuite in, “Hih ahih ding kua ahi hiam?” ci-in khat leh khat a kidong uh hi.
Amaute lakah kua lianbel hiam? ci-in nungzuite khat leh khat a kiseel uh hi.
Zeisu in, “Gentaile’ hausate in amau tungah a mang uh a; amau tungah a ukte mi hehpihpa a ci uh hi.
Ahih hangin note tua bang na hi kei ding uh hi. Note lakah a lianpen in a neupen bangin om ta hen. A makaipa in nasem bangin om ta hen.
Kua lianzaw hiam: sabuai ah tupa lianzaw hiam? Nasempa lianzaw hiam? Sabuai ah a tupa lianzaw hilo ahi hiam? ahih hangin note lakah nasempa mah bangin ka om hi.
Gimna ka thuak lai takin, note in kei tawh hong omkhawm mi na hi uh hi.
Ka pa in Kumpi Gam khat hong piak mah bangin;

note zong keima Gam sungah ka sabuai ah an ne-in tui na dawn theih nadingun note thu kong pia ding hi. Note in thukhen tokhom tungah tu-in, Israel mipawl sawm leh nihte tungah thu na khen ding uh hi,” a ci hi.
Zeisu in, “Simon, Simon aw, Satan in buhhum bangin nang hong haih nuam hi.
Ahih hangin nangma upna a siat loh nadingin ke’n thu kong ngetsak zo hi. Na kikheel kik khit ciangin ute naute na kipsak in,” a ci hi.
Simon in, “Topa aw, thong kiatna ahi zongin, sihna ahi zongin nang tawh ka thuakkhawm ngam ding hi,” a ci hi.
Zeisu in, “Piter aw, ke’n kong cih-inah, nangmah in, ‘Ke’n ka thei kei hi,’ ci-in kei thumvei nong nial matengin, tuni-in aak a khuang kei ding hi,” a ci hi.
Khatvei Zeisu in, “Dangka-ip, thung-ip, khedapte keng loin note kong sawl lai-in, na sapna uh a om hiam?” ci-in a dot ciangin, “Sapna khat beek a om kei hi,” a ci uh hi.
“Tu-in ahih leh, dangka-ip a nei mi in la ta hen. Tua mah bangin thung-ip a nei mi in la ta hen. Namsau a nei lo mi in a puan zuak hen la, namsau lei ta hen.

Ke’n kong cih-inah, ‘Amah mawhneite tawh a kisimkhawm ding hi,’ ci-in Lai Siangtho sungah a kigelhna thu in keima tungah hong tung ding hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, keima thu khempeuh in a tangtung ding hi,” a ci hi.
Amaute in, “Topa aw, namsau nih a om hi,” a cih uh ciangin, “Pha hi,” a ci hi.
Tua lai takin Zeisu paikhia a, a ngeina bangin Oliv Mual tungah kahto a, a nungzuite in a zui uh hi.
Tua mun a tun’ ciangin, “Kheemna tawh na kipelh theih nadingun thu na ngen un,” a cih khit ciangin,
a nungzuite tawh suang lot khat tan bang kikhen a,
khukdin’in, “Pa aw, na deih leh, hih hai kei tawh hong kipelhsak in. Ahih hangin keima deihna bang hi kei hen; nangma deihna bang hi ta hen,” ci-in thu a ngen hi.
Vantung panin vantungmi khat hong pai a, Zeisu’ tha a hatsak hi.
Amah gim mahmah ahih ciangin, nakpi-in thungen a, a khua-ul in lei tungah sisan malgol bangin a kia hi.
Thu a nget khit ciangin tho a, a nungzuite kiangah a paikik ciangin, amaute dahna tawh ihmu a om uh a mu hi.
Amaute kiangah, “Note in bang hangin ihmu na hi uh hiam? Tho un la, kheemna tawh na kipelh theih nadingun thu na ngen un,” a ci hi.
Zeisu in a gen lai takin mihonpi hong pai uh a, nungzui sawm-le-nihte lakah khat Judah kici in amai ah a pai hi. Zeisu nam dingin a kiangah a va naih ciangin,
Zeisu in, “Judah aw, nang in napna tawh Mihing Tapa na lehhek ding hiam?” ci-in a dong hi.
Zeisu kimkot ah a omte in a piang ding thu a theih uh ciangin, “Topa aw, kote in namsau tawh ka sat ding uh hiam?” a ci uh hi.
Khat in siampi ukpa’ nasem khat a sat leh, a bil taklam a satkhia hi.
Zeisu in, “Tua zah hisak in,” ci-a a bil a khut tawh lawngin a damsak hi.
Tua ciangin Zeisu in amah man dinga hong pai siampi liante, biakna inn mangte leh upate kiangah, “Note in galgumat bangin kei man dingin namsau leh molhtumte tawi-in hong pai na hi uh hiam?
Keimah in ni simin biakna innpi sungah note tawh ka omkhop lai takin na hong man kei uh hi. Ahih hangin hih hun in note hun leh khuamial’ vangliatna hun ahi hi,” a ci hi.
Amaute in Zeisu man uh a, siampi ukpa’ innah a paipih uh hi. Piter in gamla sim kihalin a zui hi.
Amaute in inntual lai zangah mei cih uh a, a tutkhawm khit uh ciangin, Piter zong amau lakah a tu hi.
Piter mei awi-a om numeino khat in a muh ciangin lim takin en a, “Hih mi in Zeisu tawh a kipawl hi,” a ci hi.
Piter in, “Numei aw, tua pa ke’n ka thei kei hi,” ci-in a nial hi.
Tua nung a sawt loin midang khat in Piter mu a, “Hua mite khat na hi hi,” a ci hi. Piter in, “Lawm aw, ka hi kei hi,” a ci hi.
Tua nung nai khat bang ciangin midang khat in, “Hih mi in Zeisu tawh a kipawl takpi hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, amah in Galile mi ahi hi,” ci-in uphuaina tawh a ci hi.
Piter in, “Lawm aw, nang na cih pen ke’n ka thei kei hi,” a ci hi. A gen lai takin thakhat mahin aak a khuang pah hi.
Tua lai takin Topa kihei-in Piter a en hi. Piter in, “Tuni-in aak a khuan’ ma-in nang in thumvei nong nial ding hi,” Topa in a cihna thu a phawk kik hi.
Amah pusuak a, nakpi-in a kap hi.
Zeisu a len mite in amah zahkoin a sat uh hi.
A maitang a tuam khit uh ciangin, “Nang kua in hong beeng hiam? Kamsangte bangin hong gen in,” a ci uh hi.
Kam dang tampi tawh Zeisu lang pangin a zahko uh hi.
Khua a vak ciangin mite lakah upate, siampi liante leh laitheite kikhawm uh a, Zeisu amau zumah a paipih uh hi.
“Nang Khazih na hih leh, kote hong hilh in,” a cih uh ciangin, “Ke’n kong gen leh, nong um kei ding uh hi.
Ke’n kong dot leh, nong dawng kik kei ding uh hi.
Ahih hangin tu-a kipanin Mihing Tapa in Pasian’ vangliatna ziat lamah a tu ding hi,” a ci hi.
Amaute khempeuh in, “Tua ahih leh, Pasian’ Tapa na hi hiam?” ci-in a dong uh hi. Zeisu in, “Na gen bangun ka hi hi,” a ci hi.
Tua lai takin amaute in, “Adang bang teci thu deih lai i hi hiam? Ama kam pan eite in i thei zo hi,” a ci uh hi.
